name: Mausoleum of Khoja Ahmed Yasawi
description: In the southern Kazakh city of Turkestan, this huge brick shrine honors Khoja Ahmed Yasawi, a 12th-century Sufi poet and mystic. Timur ordered it built from 1389 to replace a smaller tomb, but work stopped when he died in 1405, leaving parts unfinished. Its glazed-tile decoration and bold domes served as a trial run for Samarkand, and pilgrims still come today.
